memories.content: Postgres connection pooling reuses open connections and avoids a new TCP handshake per request.
Rust's ownership model prevents use-after-free bugs at compile time without a garbage collector.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines vector and keyword search rankings into one relevance score.
Memory decay scoring uses an exponential half-life so recently accessed items rank higher over time.
On Windows, Git Bash coreutils link.exe shadows the MSVC linker rustc needs, causing a confusing extra operand error.
BM25 inspired full text search in Postgres uses tsvector and ts_rank with a trigram similarity fallback.
Contradiction resolution marks the losing memory as superseded instead of deleting it, preserving history.
An expiration date soft hides a memory from search results without touching its decay score or deleting the row.
The Neon sync outbox drains committed transactions in small batches and halves batch size after a transport failure.
Obsidian vault ingestion splits markdown files into chunks at heading boundaries before embedding.
Reusing open Postgres connections via pooling avoids the overhead of a fresh TCP handshake for every request.
The RRF fusion weight for keyword search was set to 0.9, favoring exact term matches over semantic similarity.
A memory decay half-life of 30 days was chosen so month-old notes still rank above noise, not just this week's.
